preferredPrimitives: Native buttons, details, tables, selects and modal dialog
patterns: Inline compact problem rows with three-state column sorting
Large central retention bar and difficulty bars segmented by pattern

must: Preserve existing practice data, API, and extension

decisions.direction: Blank website frontend pending new inspiration
decisions.reason: User rejected the previous UI and requested a complete frontend reset before rebuilding from inspiration photos.

decisions.direction: Warm playful visual language, original DSA layout
decisions.reason: User selected reference 2 palette and typography, both references card styling, and phased implementation with review checkpoints.

decisions.direction: Full-page ivory canvas
decisions.reason: User requested the website cover the whole page instead of appearing as an outer card. Preserve inner cards and responsive content gutters.

decisions.direction: Moon/sun theme control
decisions.reason: User requested dark and light mode in the top bar. Default to light; persist the explicit choice. Dark surfaces use warm charcoal with cream text and colorful cards.

decisions.direction: Live coverage and retention dashboard
decisions.reason: Phase 2 connects real metrics and goals, separates dated and undated evidence, supports search, and preserves the approved visual foundation.

decisions.direction: Dedicated Patterns page and full-width rows
decisions.reason: User rejected tiled cards and inline subpatterns. Keep dashboard overview separate; each pattern navigates to its own detail panel with reloadable URLs and preserved search context.

decisions.direction: Unified coverage and retention view
decisions.reason: User requested both metrics together for comparison. Remove perspective switching and its saved preference; use consistent catalog order while preserving the dedicated Patterns and detail pages.

decisions.direction: Inline problems and two sorting controls
decisions.reason: User requested expandable problems under each subpattern, inline notebooks, Difficulty and Last practiced ascending/descending buttons, and stopping once the existing four phases are finished.

decisions.direction: Full subpattern disclosure and compact problem rows
decisions.reason: User requested full-row toggle, name/difficulty/LeetCode/date bars, three-state column sorting, and ellipsis-only pattern editing with problem-specific candidates and explicit manual placement.

decisions.direction: Remove the History page
decisions.reason: User requested removing History completely. Keep only Dashboard, Patterns and Workspace; remove history-only frontend code while preserving practice records and capture.

decisions.direction: Restore coverage priority queue
decisions.reason: User reaffirmed coverage-based ranking as core behavior. Preserve existing API goal-attention order for both patterns and subpatterns, including search; keep catalog ordering only in selection controls.

decisions.direction: Refine the completed frontend
decisions.reason: Preserve the approved full-page palette and coverage priority. Tighten hierarchy, add priority ranks and next-pattern guidance, strengthen progress contrast, consolidate CSS, use a bounded keyboard-accessible editor dialog, simplify empty states and remove unused MUI/Emotion dependencies.

decisions.direction: Patterns and retention lead the dashboard
decisions.reason: User reaffirmed patterns as the USP and requested a dominant middle retention bar plus LeetCode-colored Easy/Medium/Hard coverage bars with pattern-level hover details. Replace the decorative hero and aggregate coverage tile with assessed-pattern mean strength, clear evidence scope, coverage segments and ranked pattern links.

decisions.direction: Dashboard visual language across pattern browsing
decisions.reason: User requested retention-led metrics and difficulty bars on Patterns and subpatterns, with a visual next-action cue instead of explanatory text. Reserve mustard outline, rank badge, progress accent and play action for the first priority; keep other rows neutral. Preserve API ranking, inline disclosure and accessible names.

decisions.direction: Rank-consistent priority balance bars
decisions.reason: User requires bar fill to follow the same profile-aware queue as ranking, combining solved coverage and retention rather than plotting pure retention. Use 65% remaining goal credits plus 35% target-weighted practice weakness, including completed targets. Invert attention on a fixed goal-matrix scale; preserve true retention separately and leave Other unscored.
Higher fill means more attention needed. Show priority points and a focusable explanation of coverage/practice contributions; retain difficulty completion bars and practice strength separately.
decisions.direction: Practice priority bars follow ranking bands
Practice gap uses empty space
decisions.reason: User requested inverse fill, no hover explanations and taller bars. Remaining attention is empty; meaningful practice fills the bar. Pattern rows use 40px tracks and dashboard recommendations use 20px tracks.

Bar length is independent of interview importance. Coral/high, mustard/medium and teal/lower badges communicate emphasis. Public point scores and hover explanations are removed. Every coverage credit updates progress; persisted queue anchors gate demotion.
decisions.direction: Own-pattern progress, selected-focus emphasis, stable queue position
Equal coral focus-push and mustard retention-push halves
decisions.reason: User sketch selected split priority signals with a visible four-credit queue-release threshold. Unknown retention dates use hatching.

decisions.direction: Continuous adjacent coral/mustard stack with an internal dashed marker
decisions.reason: User rejected separately filled halves. Both weighted contributors share one uninterrupted track with remaining space at the end; no separate threshold mini-bar.

decisions.direction: Authoritative coverage marker with separate truthful next-block counters
decisions.reason: Threshold audit aligned marker and counters with API gates, added weighted revision progress, near-completion requirements and completed-goal states; the continuous coral/mustard bar is preserved.

decisions.direction: Growing foundation/retention bar with separate focus badge
decisions.reason: User approved capability fills instead of urgency. Pink uses own-pattern coverage; yellow uses current dated practice strength, including partial work. Unknown retention remains unassessed. Queue order and audited gates stay intact; the marker projects growing foundation.

evidence.use: Catalog reference only; no code installed
Historical catalog reference; perspective switching was later removed at the user's request
Segmented progress discovery; native project controls reused, no catalog code installed
